title: Guide: doing a run on another Mac
description:
Write docs/other-mac-runs.md so an agent given only a run's Kanbus issue ID can do it on a fresh Mac. Cover: cloning the repo and checking out main; the Kev environment (var/kev-venv, pinned model revision, offline model cache, start_kev.py) and the Laya environment; the exact collect command for a manifest; one heavy job at a time; committing only the finished answer files (never .partial files) to a branch named runs/<issue id>, pushing it (never main), and commenting the counts on the issue; `bd replay` is not run there.

Done when a person or agent can follow it end to end without asking anything.
